findings.highlight: I'm lucid enough to simply wait for the end
findings.evidenceJa: ならこれも夢なのだろうと納得して、目が覚めるのを待つことにした
findings.governingReading: 夢なのだろうと納得して、目が覚めるのを待つ says he accepts that this is probably a dream too and waits to wake up.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s decision to wait for waking is rewritten as lucidly waiting for “the end.”

findings.highlight: My arm is now made of blades
findings.evidenceJa: 剣そのものになった、自分の片腕があった
findings.governingReading: 剣そのものになった自分の片腕 says his one arm has itself become a sword; on waking he confirms it is not hard to the touch or transformed into a sword.
findings.explanation: A single sword-form arm becomes an arm made of multiple blades.

findings.evidenceJa: 半端に目を覚ましているっぽい藤ねえの寝息
findings.governingReading: Shirou hears Taiga's sleeping breath and judges that she seems partly awake, contrasting it with Saber's regular breathing.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes restless snoring for breathing that makes Taiga seem half-awake. This changes the local sleep description without establishing any further consequence.

findings.evidenceJa: シロウはもともと体は出来上がっていますから
findings.governingReading: His body is already fully developed; once he acquires a suitable sword form, that alone can make him a swordsman one level higher. The improvement is specifically reduced waste in his form.
findings.explanation: Saber’s concrete account of Shirou’s swordsmanship improvement is generalized into learning proper techniques.

findings.highlight: We have different physiques on top if it all. It's impossible to copy you
findings.evidenceJa: 体格も違うし、手本にするのは無理があるだろ
findings.governingReading: 体格も違うし、手本にするのは無理がある says their different builds make Saber an unreasonable or impractical model for him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s reason for not using Saber as a model becomes both ungrammatical and categorical.

findings.highlight: only at the bare minimum level
findings.evidenceJa: それはあくまで最低限戦える、というレベルです
findings.governingReading: She says he has reached only the minimum level at which he can fight; he still cannot face Saber, Archer, or Berserker alone.
findings.explanation: Saber’s warning about Shirou’s current level is rendered in a malformed comparison.
